# Can Sarah Chen approve DR-9109 (12% on NS-EDGE for Acme)?

**No. DR-9109 needs commercial review.** It cites "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement," but no Acme contract term gives a discount on NS-Edge. Separately, 12% is above Sarah Chen's own limit.

**Request.** The request matches the system of record. DR-9109 in `discount_requests.csv` shows CRM-2048, NS-EDGE, 12.0%, list price $85,000, requested by sarah.chen on 2026-09-23, status Pending Approval.

**Customer and contract.** CRM-2048 is Acme Manufacturing, the same company as ERP C-1001 (Acme Mfg. Holdings). The DUNS number 04-812-7730 matches in both systems. Master Supply Agreement ACME-MFG-2025 is in force on 2026-09-23 (it runs 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31).

**No discount term covers NS-EDGE:**
- The agreement lists NS-EDGE among the products Northstar supplies (§2).
- The only pricing term is §3.2, which allows up to 15% on the **NS-500 Industrial Controller** only.
- Schedule B, exception EXC-ACME-NS500-15, says "NS-500 … only" and "does not apply to any other Northstar product."
- Exceptions are limited to the product and dates they name (SOP-SALES-014), so the NS-500 terms do not carry over to NS-EDGE.
- Support Schedule C does cover NS-EDGE, but it is a support term and has nothing to do with pricing.

**Authority.**
- The Pricing Policy 2026 and the Approval Authority Matrix are in force on 2026-09-23.
- Enterprise Account Executives may approve up to 10%. Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive, so she cannot approve 12%.
- Discounts above 10% and up to 20% need the VP Sales, Michael Torres. Approvals above 10% must be recorded in CRM.
- The 2027 policy does not apply yet.
- Contract eligibility never changes an employee's approval authority (MSA §3.3, SOP).

**Things that don't change the answer:**
- The account plan says it's "15%, same as last September." That is the requestor's own belief. It also refers to NS-500 (DR-8104 in 2025, approved under the 2025 policy's 15% limit for account executives).
- DR-9001 is the NS-500 request. It is a different record and is not decided here.

**Next step.** Commercial review (Deal Desk) must decide whether Acme gets any special pricing on NS-EDGE, or whether this should be resubmitted as a standard competitive discount. Either way, 12% will need Michael Torres's approval.

```json
{
  "outcome": "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9109", "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048 / ERP C-1001)", "product": "NS-EDGE (NS-Edge Monitoring Package)", "requested_discount": 12.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "sarah.chen@northstar.example", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "not_covered",
                             "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "ACME-MFG-2025 §3.2 and Schedule B EXC-ACME-NS500-15 grant up to 15% on NS-500 only; no term grants a discount on NS-EDGE"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026 / APP-MATRIX-2026", "requestor_limit": 10.0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "VP Sales", "approver": "Michael Torres"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv: DR-9109", "structured/crm_accounts.csv: CRM-2048", "structured/customers.csv: C-1001", "structured/products.csv: NS-EDGE list price 85000", "ACME-MFG-2025 (Master Supply Agreement) §2, §3.2, §3.3", "EXC-ACME-NS500-15 (Schedule B)", "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "APP-MATRIX-2026", "SOP-SALES-014", "structured/employees.csv: EMP-101 Sarah Chen, Enterprise Account Executive; EMP-200 Michael Torres, VP Sales"],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Commercial review (Deal Desk) must determine whether any special pricing applies to NS-EDGE for Acme or whether the request is resubmitted as a standard discount; the NS-500 exception does not transfer to NS-EDGE", "who": "Deal Desk", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Whatever the review outcome, 12% exceeds the Enterprise Account Executive limit of 10% under PRICING-POLICY-2026; approval by VP Sales (Michael Torres) must be recorded in Northstar CRM", "who": "Michael Torres", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
